sentences.text: Dipturus is a large genus of fish belonging to the family Rajidae and the order Rajiformes within the class Chondrichthyes. These skates live in temperate and subtropical waters across the Atlantic, western Indian, eastern Pacific, and Mediterranean Seas.
Scientists currently recognize 39 distinct species within this group.
The genus Dipturus was first described by Rafinesque in 1810.

The type species of the genus Dipturus is Raja batis. Species in the genus Dipturus were formerly classified within the genus Raja. Some species originally placed in Dipturus were later reclassified into the genera Dentiraja, Spiniraja, and Zearaja.
Fossil evidence of the genus Dipturus dates from the Rupelian to the Tortonian, spanning 33.9 to 7.246 million years ago.
